input.free_text_description: This system is a authentication platform that serves User, Content Creator roles. It manages core business objects including user, authentication request, authentication response, cerberus user. The platform provides capabilities for entry point unauthorized handler, security, security. The system includes access control and identity verification to protect resources and manage sessions. Secondary concerns include user management functionality.

user_stories.story: As a User, I want to securely sign in to the system, so that I can access my personalized resources.
As a User, I want to create and manage user records, so that I can track and organize user data effectively.
As a User, I want to create and manage authentication request records, so that I can track and organize authentication request data effectively.
As a User, I want to create and manage authentication response records, so that I can track and organize authentication response data effectively.
As a User, I want to create and manage cerberus user records, so that I can track and organize cerberus user data effectively.
